description: Source file implementing filesystem monitoring utilities for Darwin (macOS), including functions to get filesystem info, check if filesystem is remote, and handle synthetic firmlink aliases.

methods.name: fsmonitor__get_fs_info
methods.description: Retrieves filesystem information for a given path, including filesystem type and whether it is remote.

methods.name: fsmonitor__is_fs_remote
methods.description: Checks if the filesystem at the given path is remote.

methods.name: fsmonitor__get_alias
methods.description: Scans root directory for synthetic firmlinks that resolve to a prefix of the given path.

methods.name: fsmonitor__resolve_alias
methods.description: Resolves a given path using alias information to produce the actual path.
